verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is a code-first engine shipped as tree-shakable ES6 NPM packages. A project is therefore built with standard command-line JS tooling, with no editor in the loop. Its documented server-side support and NullEngine allow the engine to run headless, for example in CI. missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on CLI build/export pipelines or CI recipes, independent or hands-on corroboration of headless CI builds, and evidence that asset exporting (the Max/Maya/Blender exporters) can run without an editor.
